LanguageData.SEC_Trait_DrillSergeant.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} has rich experience in training new recruits, {PAWN_pronoun} can turn a civilian into a reliable soldier within a few months.
LanguageData.SEC_Trait_Service_Protocol_Overloaded.de: {PAWN_nameDef}'s serving protocol is overloaded, she won't refuse any demands and sometimes even requests orders from others.
LanguageData.SEC_Trait_SpecialSecretary_Masterchef.de: {PAWN_nameDef}'s culinary skills are second to none in the entire Secretary Nexus. The dishes she prepares are both delicious and perfectly safe, which has made her highly popular among all clans.
LanguageData.SEC_Trait_StylishBunny.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has accumulated extensive combat, crafting, and artistic skills over a military career spanning hundreds of years. She believes her understanding of fashion and craftsmanship has become a school of its own. Quite fond of teaching others and eager for attention, she does not hesitate to share her insights across various fields with anyone willing to listen.
